title: Tony-Winning ‘Hadestown’ Musical Arrives on Digital Ahead of Blu-ray & DVD Release
summary: Anaïs Mitchell’s acclaimed musical, which won eight Tony Awards, including Best Musical, is making its way from the stage to the home screen.
contentText:

Hadestown has already conquered Broadway , the West End and, apparently, the box office. Now, the Tony-winning musical is heading home. As of today (Aug. 25), Hadestown: The Musical is now available to purchase or rent digitally, with Blu-ray and DVD editions due out on Oct. 20. Both physical versions are currently available for preorder.

The filmed stage production had an impressive run in theaters after opening across North America on July 24. In its first weekend, it earned $10.2 million, beating the $10.1 million opening weekend of Hamilton ’s theatrical stage capture in 2025. The result made Hadestown the biggest opening for a live theater capture at the North American box office.

And audiences weren’t exactly ready to say goodbye. The film brought in another $8 million in its second week, pushing its domestic total to $18.2 million.

For anyone who didn’t make it to the theater, there’s an easier way to see what all the fuss is about. Starting today, the filmed musical is available for digital purchase and rental through services including Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV. On both platforms, the purchase price is $24.99, while a 48-hour rental is listed at $19.99.

And if you’d rather own a copy, the Blu-ray and DVD editions are already available for preorder on Amazon ahead of their October release.

OFFICIAL DIGITAL RELEASE

Watch 'Hadestown: The Musical' on Prime Video

$24.99

Rent/Buy on prime video

The digital purchase is expected to be $24.99, while rentals will cost around $19.99 for 48 hours.

The filmed version of Hadestown is now available on Prime Video, following its theatrical release. The musical centers on Orpheus and Eurydice as they navigate the underworld, alongside the story of Hades and Persephone.

AVAILABLE IN 4K

Watch 'Hadestown: The Musical' on Apple TV

Rent/buy On Apple TV

The Tony-winning musical is also available for purchase at $24.99, and rented for $19.99 (at a two-day period).

Many viewers prefer Apple TV for its strong picture quality, particularly when streaming movies and shows in 4K. Some users also report that Apple TV can deliver higher video bitrates than built-in smart TV apps on certain services, which may result in a sharper, more detailed image. If you’re looking to get as close as possible to the visual quality of a Broadway production from home, the Apple TV 4K rental is a worthwhile option, especially if you already have a Apple TV box.

PREORDER NOW

'Hadestown: The Musical' (Blu-ray)

$32.99

Buy Now on amazon

Set to release Oct. 20 on Amazon.

Filmed live at London’s Lyric Theatre, the production captures the acclaimed stage show featuring Reeve Carney as Orpheus, Eva Noblezada as Eurydice, Patrick Page as Hades, Amber Gray as Persephone and André De Shields as Hermes. With Anaïs Mitchell’s folk- and jazz-infused score at its center, the filmed production brings the award-winning musical’s mythological story to the screen.

OFFICIAL DVD RELEASE

'Hadestown: The Musical' (DVD)

$26.99

Also set to officially release on Oct 20. on Amazon.

Directed by Brett Sullivan, the 141-minute musical follows Orpheus and Eurydice through Anaïs Mitchell’s modern retelling of the Greek myth, set to a score blending American folk and New Orleans-inspired jazz. The DVD is slated for release Oct. 20.

BEST FOR THEATRE FANS

'Hadestown' – Piano/Vocal Selections Songbook by Anaïs Mitchell

$23.26 $25.99 11% off

Revisit Hadestown with 12 songs from Anaïs Mitchell’s Tony-winning score, created for musicians and theater fans.

If Hadestown ’s music has been stuck in your head, this official songbook gives you a way to play it yourself. The 12-song collection includes piano and vocal arrangements, along with guitar chord symbols for each selection. It’s a useful addition for musicians, singers or Broadway fans who want a closer look at Mitchell’s acclaimed score.

The filmed version was captured across three performances at London’s Lyric Theatre in February and March 2025, with Brett Sullivan directing the proshot production.

The musical, written by Mitchell and originally directed by Rachel Chavkin, reimagines the Greek myths of Orpheus and Eurydice and Hades and Persephone with a score rooted in American folk and New Orleans-inspired jazz.

Hadestown first arrived on Broadway in 2019 and went on to win eight Tony Awards, including Best Musical. Now, after making its mark on the big screen, it’s getting another life at home.
